[Unit]
Description=BEN server (BEN (64)), lane %i
Requires=benlane-netns@%i.service
After=benlane-netns@%i.service

[Service]
User=bridgebots
NetworkNamespacePath=/run/netns/benlane-%i
WorkingDirectory=/home/bridgebots/work/ben
EnvironmentFile=/home/bridgebots/work/lanes/%i.env
Environment=HOME=/home/bridgebots PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 TF_NUM_INTRAOP_THREADS=1 TF_NUM_INTEROP_THREADS=1 TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3
ExecStart=/home/bridgebots/work/ben-venv/bin/python src/gameapi.py --config ${BEN_CONF} --host 127.0.0.1 --port ${BEN_PORT} --record false
StandardOutput=append:/home/bridgebots/work/lanes/%i.ben.log
StandardError=append:/home/bridgebots/work/lanes/%i.ben.log
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
